programs.title: Pokemon the Series: Ruby & Sapphire
programs.desc: Ash meets Morrison, another Trainer who's on his way to compete in the Hoenn League, and the two immediately become fierce rivals!

programs.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent Down Under
programs.desc: Today's undercover operation finds Phil in Sydney, where he's helping Courtney Phipps and Craig Wright, formerly of Edinburgh, to find a two bedroom apartment in the highly sought after central city.

programs.title: Cast Away
programs.desc: A manager for an American courier service has to fend for himself when a plane crash leaves him stranded alone on a desert island. Initially panic-stricken, he overcomes his terror to survive for four years on his own before building a raft and setting off on an epic journey back home. Adventure drama, starring Tom Hanks, Helen Hunt, Nick Searcy, Lari White and Chris Noth.

programs.title: ER
programs.desc: Weaver deals with the upsetting demand to give up her son; Abby tries to help a seizure-prone mother; Neela saves a fellow researcher's life; Kem makes a return to the city; Carter changes the mission of his family's foundation.

programs.title: My Family
programs.desc: The Harpers star in a documentary about family life as part of Abi's latest college assignment. Susan is happy to present a facade of domestic bliss and dispense cookery tips along with relationship advice. Ben, however, is more concerned with catching a rogue rodent.

programs.title: QI
programs.desc: Stephen Fry hosts an episode themed around gifts, blending sharp wit with fascinating facts. He is joined by Jan Ravens, Jimmy Carr, Clive Anderson, and Alan Davies, who bring their trademark humor, quick comebacks, and playful banter to the panel, creating a lively mix of knowledge, comedy, and entertaining surprises throughout.
